source_authored_vs_completion.printed: The authors specify iid Exp(1) clocks, the integrated-hazard first crossing, finite flow/bounce updates, stopping at an empty crossing set, and attribute A.7 to clock iteration. The later A.2 paragraph explicitly discusses Borel hazards/crossings/recursion.
source_authored_vs_completion.ASTIS_completion: The unnormalized survival identity at a random current state and a measurable history-duration parameter is an explicit ASTIS probability completion of that iteration. It is not a printed standalone theorem or a completed A.7 proof.

recommended_single_bounded_target.fixed_inputs: Retain original six analytic assumptions: alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V C2, both alpha/beta Hessian bounds for every x,v, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Fixed deterministic y/reference/z0 and deterministic finite event depth n. Use the actual literal stopped recursion and original iid input law.
recommended_single_bounded_target.objects: H_n is the complete finite tagged record history at depths0..n. L_n is the event that its final record is live(T_n,Z_n). Raw coordinate n is source E_(n+1), with NNReal clipping an explicitly declared ambient null-set extension only.
recommended_single_bounded_target.test_class: For every Borel history event A and every deterministic Borel measurable function d:History_n->[0,infinity), use duration d(H_n). No boundedness of d is required: every value is a finite nonnegative real and each finite-time hazard is finite.
recommended_single_bounded_target.unnormalized_formula: P(H_n in A AND L_n AND tau_(Z_n)(epsilon_n)>d(H_n)) = integral over (H_n^-1(A) intersect L_n) of exp(-Lambda_(Z_n)(d(H_n))) dP.
recommended_single_bounded_target.total_tagged_weight: Equivalently integrate over H_n^-1(A) the tagged weight W_d(history): live(T,z) maps to exp(-Lambda_z(d(history))), stopped maps to0. The event is explicitly live-guarded; no phase at infinity or next wait after stopping is assigned.
recommended_single_bounded_target.equivalent_conditioning_sense: For the indicator of the live-guarded survival event, conditional expectation given sigma(H_n) equals W_d(H_n) almost surely. The unnormalized event-integral identity suffices and avoids introducing a regular conditional distribution.
recommended_single_bounded_target.one_edge_reason: A universal measurable-duration interface contains the fixed-u case and supports the actual random remaining-horizon consumer. Do not introduce repeated wrapper lemmas for constant u versus d(H_n).

duration_assumption_audit.analytic_assumptions: The six actual PBPS analytic hypotheses remain unchanged; Measurable d is not a seventh assumption on V, the process, initial state or clock law.
duration_assumption_audit.function_domain: Measurable d restricts the admissible deterministic test-function class, like MeasurableSet A restricts test events. Relative to the printed paper it is an explicitly attributed source-implicit/generalized interface, not a claim that the authors wrote this free-function binder.
duration_assumption_audit.no_provider_premises: Actual history/last-live-state/hazard measurability, threshold-clock independence, product law, nonnegative hazard and threshold-crossing equivalence must be dependencies proved or consumed internally, never assumptions supplied by the caller.
duration_assumption_audit.forbidden_shortcut: A formal theorem for a separately assumed random state independent of a separately assumed clock is only generic infrastructure until actual generated history and next input clock discharge its conditions.
duration_assumption_audit.source_consumer_specialization: For fixed physical horizon T>=0, d_T(history)=max(T-last_live_time,0), with any declared stopped-branch value under the live guard, is Borel by finite projections/tagged cases/continuous clipping. Establish this specialization internally when consumed; a measurable d cannot inspect unused tail coordinates.

independent_mathematical_derivation: The tagged last record and any measurable d(H_n) depend only on consumed clocks, using accepted I1-I3.
The next raw input remains an independent Exp(1) coordinate; projecting the full unused tail preserves this law.
For each live z and finite duration u, continuity and monotonicity of the integrated hazard give tau_z(e)>u iff e>Lambda_z(u), including flat/zero hazards and empty crossing sets.

Joint measurability of the hazard and d makes the random-threshold event measurable. Use the joint product law and Tonelli/nonnegative parameter integration to evaluate the independent exponential tail at Lambda_z(d(h)).
Retain the live guard and integrate this survival weight over arbitrary measurable history events. This yields an unnormalized formula even for null events; no point-history division is used.

The bound 0<=exp(-Lambda)<=1 follows from nonnegative intensity, so no extra integrability or domination premise is needed. A nonnegative lintegral formulation can avoid analytic integration providers entirely.

conditioning_and_stopping.deterministic_depth: n is deterministic even though T_n and Z_n are random. This distinction permits iid input independence after a finite generated prefix.
conditioning_and_stopping.duration_not_stopping_time: d(H_n) is a past-measurable duration for the next arc, not a random index or a future-informed physical stopping time.
conditioning_and_stopping.random_parameter_warning: For each fixed u, a conditional identity may have a different null exceptional set. Substitution of random d(H_n) is not justified from those separate identities alone; derive the jointly measurable parameter identity directly.
conditioning_and_stopping.stopped_history: Source recursion has no next phase state after stopping. Restrict to L_n, or declare a totalization and use matching stopped-branch weights. The recommended formula uses stopped weight0 and retains every stopped history without pretending its next event exists.
conditioning_and_stopping.physical_time: N_T generally uses the current unused clock through observed survival. The original unused exponential is then truncated; conditional memorylessness of its residual is separate. No random-index restart or Markov theorem follows here.
conditioning_and_stopping.null_events: If P(H_n in A)=0 both sides of the unnormalized formula vanish. Do not normalize and do not claim a conditional probability at each exact continuous history.

endpoints_and_infinite_waits.crossing: Source crossing uses >= at nonnegative times; survival uses strict tau>u and therefore strict E>Lambda(u). Continuity/closedness handles equality correctly, without requiring strictly increasing hazard.
endpoints_and_infinite_waits.duration_zero: At u=0, Lambda=0 and a positive exponential clock gives survival probability1 on every live history. Zero raw clocks occur only on a null ambient set; the deterministic crossing still has tau(0)=0.
endpoints_and_infinite_waits.zero_rate: A live zero-rate arc has Lambda identically0 and infinite next wait for positive clocks; survival through every finite duration is1. No positive-rate or finite-next-jump hypothesis is legal.
endpoints_and_infinite_waits.infinite_wait: The finite-duration formula includes tau=infinity automatically. It does not assert that the finite-wait law is proper.
endpoints_and_infinite_waits.limiting_mass: If L=lim_(u->infinity)Lambda_z(u), the infinite-wait mass is exp(-L), with exp(-infinity)=0, after a separate limit/measure-continuity argument. Exact equality at a finite total-hazard limit depends on whether the limit is attained, but the independent continuous clock makes that boundary conditionally null. Do not assert a pathwise > versus >= total-hazard criterion without this distinction.
endpoints_and_infinite_waits.finite_horizon: d_T=(T-T_n)_+ is a valid measurable duration. Actual n-event-before-T assembly also requires live T_n<T or the precise endpoint convention; that history event can be absorbed into A, but its ordered-time density integration remains I5.

candidate_acceptance_requirements: Retain the literal actual flow/rate/hazard/crossing/stopped history, with explicit source raw-to-NNReal clock indexing.
Quantify deterministic n and measurable history-duration d; derive actual-history and random-hazard measurability and input independence internally.
Prove live-guarded strict survival against the source >=-crossing, without positive-rate/finite-wait or normalized-history assumptions.
Evaluate a jointly measurable random threshold directly; do not replace it with a fixed-state/fixed-duration wrapper or assume the desired factorization.
Keep unrestricted measurable A including null events, stopped histories, zero duration/rate/normal, and infinite waiting possibilities.
